summary: Creates 3D text as POP geometry, including line-strip and triangle output workflows. Useful for text that needs to participate in POP attribute processing and rendering.

key_params.name: connectivity
key_params.note: Choose triangles or line strips for generated text geometry

key_params.name: mode
key_params.note: Use the Text parameter or Specification DAT/CHOP mode

key_params.name: specdat
key_params.note: Specification Table DAT for multi-block text

key_params.name: specchop
key_params.note: Specification CHOP with numeric per-block overrides

key_concepts: line-strip outlines and triangle text output
Table DAT and CHOP text-block overrides
tracking, line spacing, word wrap, font size, and text color overrides
append positioning for sequential text blocks
common_gotchas: Text POP arrived with TD 2025 POP releases; guard compatibility for earlier builds.
Font file behavior changed in later 2025 builds, so retest text projects after TD upgrades.
Dense triangle text can be heavier than line strips; validate cook time before using it for live typography.
